exactTheorem: Let alphabet A_H be all H-bit columns with no vertical monochrome 4-interval. Transition (a,b,c)->(b,c,d) permitted iff all real horizontal/rising/falling original K4 lines in these four columns are nonmonochrome. Sum products of transitions, weighting each column by z^(P0-owned site count), yields the EXACT generating polynomial Z_WH(z) for all K4-free fully colored true board cells.
